dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's the art building. Art students study there.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ði ˈɑːrt ˌbɪldɪŋ. ˈɑːrt ˌstuːdənts ˈstʌdi ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And the big building over there?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈbɪɡ ˈbɪldɪŋ ˌoʊvər ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Economics and accounting. My friend studies accounting there.
dialogue.reading: ˌɛkəˈnɑːmɪks ənd əˈkaʊntɪŋ. maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈstʌdiz əˈkaʊntɪŋ ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's next to the hospital.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈhɑːspɪtəl.
